title: Mammalian conservation of endogenous G-quadruplex reveals their associations with complex traits.
authors: Zhang, Ze-Hao; Wang, Zi-Yan; Li, Cong-Hui; Qian, Sheng Hu; Zhang, Wen; Chen, Zhen-Xia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究哺乳动物保守内源G-四链体(eG4)的进化特征及其与复杂性状的关联，虽非TF-DNA结合体系，但涉及DNA结构调控元件与转录因子亲和力，并采用大语言模型预测工具，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: DNA G-quadruplexes (G4s) are four-stranded DNA structures. Endogenous G-quadruplexes (eG4s) have been identified as pivotal regulatory elements for gene expression in the human genome. The measurement of evolutionary conservation can be employed to ascertain the functional relevance of putative regulatory elements. However, the evolutionary profiles of human eG4s remain largely unknown. RESULTS: Here, we construct mammalian evolutionary profiles of human eG4s based on a comprehensive reference annotation of human eG4s from the integration of the eG4 database EndoQuad covering 41 human cell lines and our home-made G4 CUT&Tag data covering seven cell lines. We find that transposable elements contribute substantially to the evolutionary spread of primate-specific eG4s. A total of 92,910 highly conserved human eG4s were identified under mammalian constraint. By developing and utilizing the eG4 prediction tool eG4finder, which is based on a large language model, we verify the high structural conservation of highly conserved eG4s. The enrichment of highly conserved eG4s in developmental and aging pathways highlights their potential significance in key biological processes. Notably, highly conserved eG4s exhibit higher regulatory potential, regulatory activity and affinity for transcription factors. We demonstrate that highly conserved eG4s are the most powerful transcriptional activation elements in the total eG4 collection. Meanwhile, trait-associated variants and variants affecting the expression of high phenotypic severity genes are most enriched in highly conserved eG4s. CONCLUSIONS: Our study highlights the important regulatory functions and close association with complex human traits of human eG4s that are highly conserved in the mammalian lineage.
abstract_zh: 背景：DNA G-四链体（G4s）是四链DNA结构。内源性G-四链体（eG4s）已被确定为人基因组中基因表达的关键调控元件。进化保守性的测量可用于确定推定调控元件的功能相关性。然而，人类eG4s的进化谱系在很大程度上仍属未知。结果：在此，我们基于综合参考注释，整合了涵盖41种人类细胞系的eG4数据库EndoQuad及我们自制的覆盖七种细胞系的G4 CUT&Tag数据，构建了人类eG4s的哺乳动物进化谱系。我们发现转座元件对灵长类特异性eG4s的进化扩展贡献显著。在哺乳动物约束下，共鉴定出92,910个高度保守的人类eG4s。通过开发并利用基于大语言模型的eG4预测工具eG4finder，我们验证了高度保守eG4s的高结构保守性。高度保守eG4s在发育和衰老通路中的富集凸显了它们在关键生物过程中的潜在重要性。值得注意的是，高度保守eG4s表现出更高的调控潜力、调控活性和对转录因子的亲和力。我们证明，在全部eG4集合中，高度保守eG4s是最强的转录激活元件。同时，与性状相关的变异及影响高表型严重性基因表达的变异在高度保守eG4s中富集最为显著。结论：我们的研究强调了在哺乳动物谱系中高度保守的人类eG4s的重要调控功能及其与复杂人类性状的密切关联。
